instruction: Explain the steps to activate the background cone option in VLC, given that it's not found in the settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
